name: latex
description: Compile LaTeX with bundled Tectonic for simple projects and TeX Live or MacTeX for full projects.

shortDescription.en-US: Compile LaTeX with Tectonic or TeX Live
shortDescription.zh-CN: 使用 Tectonic 或 TeX Live 编译 LaTeX

longDescription.en-US: LaTeX workflows for Codex that use bundled Tectonic first for simple projects, fall back to detected TeX Live or MacTeX for fuller projects, validate local LaTeX readiness, and optionally install a Codex-managed full TeX Live runtime only when no usable system installation is present.
longDescription.zh-CN: Codex 的 LaTeX 工作流：简单项目优先使用内置 Tectonic，复杂项目回退到检测到的 TeX Live 或 MacTeX，验证本地 LaTeX 就绪状态，并且仅在没有可用系统安装时选择性安装由 Codex 管理的完整 TeX Live 运行时。

defaultPrompt: Use latex-doctor to check whether this machine can compile LaTeX.
Use latex-compile to build the main TeX file in this project, trying Tectonic first when the project is simple.
Use texlive-runtime-installer to install managed full TeX Live only if no existing TeX Live is detected.

skillPreviews.name: latex-compile
skillPreviews.description: Compile a TeX project from Codex, trying bundled Tectonic for simple projects and falling back to detected TeX Live or MacTeX when needed.

skillPreviews.name: latex-doctor
skillPreviews.description: Detect bundled Tectonic plus TeX Live or MacTeX availability, report missing LaTeX tools, and run small compile smoke tests when possible.

skillPreviews.name: texlive-runtime-installer
skillPreviews.description: Detect existing TeX Live or MacTeX first, then optionally install a Codex-managed full TeX Live runtime only when no existing TeX Live installation is detected.
